name: Privileged access obtained
statement: A principal was given a privileged role or permission. Treat what it governs as under attacker control until reviewed.

name: Credentials exposed
statement: Secrets, keys, certificates or stored passwords were read. Treat them as known to the attacker.

name: Persistence established
statement: A way back in was created: a credential, a run key, a task or a service. Access survives a password reset.

name: Valid identity used
statement: The attacker signed in as an identity that exists. Sign-in controls did not stop it.

name: Known threat infrastructure involved
statement: The evidence names infrastructure on the watchlist, which ties the activity to a known actor.

name: Data collected
statement: Mail, chat or documents were read in bulk. Treat their content as disclosed.

name: Data may have left the environment
statement: A transfer out was run. Confirm what was sent and where.

name: Outside hosts contacted
statement: Files or commands were fetched from, or a channel was opened to, hosts outside the environment.

name: Movement to other systems
statement: Tools that reach other systems were run. Hosts beyond this one may be affected.

name: Defences and logging impaired
statement: Logs were cleared or security tooling was interfered with. Records of this period are incomplete.

name: Recovery impaired
statement: Backups, shadow copies or boot settings were changed. Recovery may fail when it is needed.

name: Code run outside normal controls
statement: Code was run in ways that avoid application control and leave little on disk.

name: Traces hidden
statement: Files or history were removed or disguised. What is left on the host is incomplete.

name: Commands generated by an AI agent
statement: The scripts were written by an AI agent, which is the premise of this tool. Generated commands differ from run to run, so a detection that matches exact text misses them.

name: Environment mapped
statement: Identities, resources or configuration were listed. Later steps were probably aimed with the result.
